Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Restricted FS Cx; FS Restriction Rate.

Avg % of FIELD-SALES customers (active on trips in last 90 days) whose restriction_status is 'RESTRICTED'.
SQL:
SELECT AVG(daily_pct) FROM (
  SELECT date::date AS day,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN restriction_status = 'RESTRICTED' THEN code END) * 100.0
         / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT code), 0) AS daily_pct
  FROM analytics.fact_consigner_restriction_status a
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT consigner_user_code AS code, assigned_sales_team
        FROM fact_consigner_demands_lead_source) b USING (code)
  WHERE assigned_sales_team = 'FIELD SALES'
  GROUP BY 1
);

Meaning / Logic: Of signups whose 1st trip happened within specified n-conversion days
SQL:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, login_date, acq_date) <= 29
                           THEN consigner_user_code END) * 1.0
     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT consigner_user_code), 0)
FROM (SELECT consigner_user_code, login_date,
             MAX(CASE WHEN trip_rank = 1 THEN latest_acq_time END)
                 OVER (PARTITION BY consigner_user_code)::date AS acq_date
      FROM fact_consigner_demands_lead_source WHERE cx_segment = 'New')
WHERE login_date <= CURRENT_DATE - 30;

Meaning / Logic: Share of signups who opened a vehicle-type browsing session within specified n-conversion days
SQL:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, f.login_date, v.vt_time) <= 29
                           THEN f.consigner_user_code END) * 1.0
     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.consigner_user_code), 0)
FROM fact_consigner_demands_lead_source f
LEFT JOIN (SELECT consigner_code,
                  MIN(TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + created / 1000000.0 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS vt_time
           FROM fact_cx_vt_browsing GROUP BY 1) v
       ON v.consigner_code = f.consigner_user_code
WHERE f.cx_segment = 'New' AND f.login_date <= CURRENT_DATE - 30;

Meaning / Logic: Of acquired Cxs matured 30 days, the share who took a 2nd trip within specified n-conversion days of the first.

                           THEN a.consigner_user_code END) * 1.0
     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.consigner_user_code), 0)
FROM fact_consigner_demands_lead_source a
LEFT JOIN fact_consigner_demands_lead_source b
       ON b.consigner_user_code = a.consigner_user_code
      AND b.demand_time > a.demand_time
      AND b.trip_flag = 1 AND b.placement_rank = 2
WHERE a.cx_segment = 'New' AND a.trip_flag = 1
  AND a.demand_date <= CURRENT_DATE - 30;

Meaning / Logic:
Cxs with a first trip, who took ≥1 trip within 90 days of that acquisition date are retention base. 
Share of the qualified cohort that took a trip in a later 90-day bucket.
SQL:
WITH acq AS (
    SELECT consigner_user_code,
           MIN(CASE WHEN trip_rank = 1 THEN latest_acq_time END)::date AS acq_date
    FROM fact_consigner_demands_lead_source GROUP BY 1
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT a.consigner_user_code, a.acq_date
    FROM acq a
    JOIN fact_consigner_demands_lead_source f
      ON f.consigner_user_code = a.consigner_user_code AND f.trip_flag = 1
     AND f.demand_date >= a.acq_date AND f.demand_date < a.acq_date + 90
    WHERE a.acq_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN x.active = 1 THEN x.consigner_user_code END) * 1.0
     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT x.consigner_user_code), 0)
FROM (SELECT q.consigner_user_code, q.acq_date,
             MAX(CASE WHEN f.trip_flag = 1
                       AND f.demand_date >= q.acq_date + 181
                       AND f.demand_date <  q.acq_date + 271 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active
      FROM qualified q
      JOIN fact_consigner_demands_lead_source f
        ON f.consigner_user_code = q.consigner_user_code
      GROUP BY 1, 2) x
WHERE CURRENT_DATE >= x.acq_date + 271

Meaning / Logic: % DR cancelled by consigner before placement
SQL:
WITH ss AS (
  select * 
        from(
                select 
                a.demand_id,
                a.sub_status,
                a.created_by,
                case when a.sub_status like 'DR%' then a.created end as dr_status_time,
                max(dr_status_time) over (partition by a.demand_id) as max_dr_status_time,
                lag(a.created) over (partition by a.demand_id order by a.created) as prev_created_time
                from mp_analytics_core.fact_demand_sub_status a
                where a.created >= '2025-10-01'
                ) a
        where prev_created_time = max_dr_status_time
)
select case when {{timeframe_type}} like 'DoD' then demand_date
                when {{timeframe_type}} like 'WoW' then demand_week
                when {{timeframe_type}} like 'MoM' then demand_month end as "Day/Week/Month"
        , count(distinct case when plc_flag = 0 and reason='CX_cancelled' then demand_id end)*1.0/nullif(count(distinct case when dr_flag = 1 then demand_id end),0) as "% DR(Cx Cancel)"

    from (
        select a.*
                , case when (b0.sub_status='CANCELLED' and b0.created_by!='consigner@wheelseye.com') or b0.sub_status in ('FREIGHT_PFC') then 'Vehicle_Not_Found' 
                              when b0.sub_status='CANCELLED' and b0.created_by='consigner@wheelseye.com' then 'CX_cancelled' end as reason   
        from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source
                left join base0 b0 on a.demand_id=b0.demand_id 
        )       
    group by 1

case when {{timeframe_type}} like 'DoD' then demand_date
         when {{timeframe_type}} like 'WoW' then demand_week
         when {{timeframe_type}} like 'MoM' then demand_month end as "Day/Week/Month"
, count(distinct case when accepted<cancelled then demand_id end)*1.0/nullif(count(distinct case when accepted is not null then demand_id end),0)as "% Plc Accepted then cancelled"

                        from mp_analytics_critical.fact_consignments

                        from mp_analytics_core.fact_consignment_cancellations
                        group by demand_id
                ) cx on a.demand_id = cx.demand_id
                
                where plc_flag=1
      )
group by 1

Metric: CX Initiated, CX Induced GTL cancellation
Meaning / Logic: % of accepted placements that got cancelled by Consigner and induced party was Consigner
SQL:
select demand_date, 
,count(distinct case when cx_initiated_cx_induced=1 then demand_id end)*1.0/nullif(count(distinct case when accepted=1 then demand_id end),0) as "% cx_initiated_cx_induced"
from (
                select a.*, acc.accepted
                , case when acc.accepted = 1 and cxl.cx_cx = 1 then 1 else 0 end as cx_initiated_cx_induced
                , case when acc.accepted = 1 and cxl.cx_fo = 1 then 1 else 0 end as cx_initiated_fo_induced
                , case when acc.accepted = 1 and cxl.fo_fo = 1 then 1 else 0 end as fo_initiated_fo_induced

                        from mp_analytics_critical.fact_consignments
                        group by demand_id
                        ) acc on a.demand_id = acc.demand_id
                left join (
                        select demand_id
                        , max(case when cancelled_by in ('consigner@wheelseye.com','SYSTEM') and induced_party = 'Consigner' then 1 else 0 end) as cx_cx
                        , max(case when cancelled_by in ('consigner@wheelseye.com','SYSTEM') and induced_party = 'Operator'  then 1 else 0 end) as cx_fo

                        from mp_analytics_core.fact_consignment_cancellations
                        group by demand_id

        )a
group by 1

                        , max(case when cancelled_by in ('consigner@wheelseye.com','SYSTEM') and induced_party = 'Consigner' then 1 else 0 end) as cx_cx
                        , max(case when cancelled_by in ('consigner@wheelseye.com','SYSTEM') and induced_party = 'Operator'  then 1 else 0 end) as cx_fo
                        , max(case when cancelled_by = 'OPERATOR_APP'        and induced_party = 'Operator'  then 1 else 0 end) as fo_fo
                        , max(case when cancelled_by = 'OPERATOR_APP'        and induced_party = 'Consigner'  then 1 else 0 end) as fo_cx
                        from mp_analytics_core.fact_consignment_cancellations
                        group by demand_id
                        ) cxl on a.demand_id = cxl.demand_id
        )a
group by 1

Meaning / Logic: Avg trips per trip active consigner
SQL:
SELECT
  sum(DISTINCT case when trip_flag=1 then demand_id end) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT case when trip_flag=1 then customer_code end), 0) AS trips_per_cx
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED';

Metric: Vehicle replacement post GTL Cancellation(Reason : CX Initiated,CX Induced)
Meaning / Logic: % of post GTL cancellation that got re-placed (Cancellation by Consigner and induced party = Consigner)
SQL:
with cx_cancel as (
    select demand_id, min(cancel_time) as cx_cancel_time
    from mp_analytics_core.fact_consignment_cancellations
    where cancelled_by in ('consigner@wheelseye.com','SYSTEM')
      and induced_party = 'Consigner'
    group by 1
),
acc as (
    select demand_id, max(case when gtl_time is not null then 1 else 0 end) as accepted
    from mp_analytics_critical.fact_consignments
    group by 1
),
repl as (
    select c.demand_id,
           max(case when f.consignment_time > c.cx_cancel_time then 1 else 0 end) as replaced
    from cx_cancel c
    join mp_analytics_critical.fact_consignments f on f.demand_id = c.demand_id
    group by 1
),
fo as (
    select c.demand_id,
           1 as backout,
           case when r.replaced = 1 then 1 else 0 end as conv
    from cx_cancel c
    join acc a on a.demand_id = c.demand_id and a.accepted = 1
    left join repl r on r.demand_id = c.demand_id
)
select
case when {{timeframe_type}} like 'DoD' then demand_date
	 when {{timeframe_type}} like 'WoW' then demand_week
	 when {{timeframe_type}} like 'MoM' then demand_month end as "Day/Week/Month"
, count(distinct case when conv = 1 then demand_id end)*1.0
  / nullif(count(distinct case when backout = 1 then demand_id end),0) as "% cx_init_cx_ind_replaced"
from (select *
	from (
		select a.*, fo.conv, fo.backout
		from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source a
		join fo on a.demand_id = fo.demand_id
		)a
					)
group by 1,2

Meaning / Logic: Of placements the FO accepted and that were not auto-cancelled, the share that became a fulfilled trip.
SQL:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN accepted IS NOT NULL AND auto_cancelled IS NULL
                            AND trip_flag = 1 THEN demand_id END) * 1.0
     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN accepted IS NOT NULL AND auto_cancelled IS NULL
                                  THEN demand_id END), 0)
FROM (SELECT a.demand_id, a.demand_date, a.trip_flag, fc.accepted, cx.auto_cancelled
      FROM fact_consigner_demands_lead_source a
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT demand_id, MAX(gtl_time) AS accepted
                 FROM mp_analytics_critical.fact_consignments GROUP BY 1) fc
             ON fc.demand_id = a.demand_id
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT demand_id,
                        MAX(CASE WHEN cancel_remarks = 'AUTO_CANCELLED_NO_ACTIVITY'
                                 THEN cancel_time END) AS auto_cancelled
                 FROM fact_consignment_cancellations GROUP BY 1) cx
             ON cx.demand_id = a.demand_id
      WHERE a.plc_flag = 1);

Meaning / Logic: Share of fulfilled trips carrying any discount.
SQL:
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(edpe_bonus,0) + COALESCE(fo_activation_bonus,0)
                     + COALESCE(middle_share_bonus,0)
                     + COALESCE(shipper_discount,0) - COALESCE(shipper_discount_reversal,0) > 0
                  THEN demand_id END) * 1.0
     / NULLIF(COUNT(demand_id), 0)
FROM mp_demand_details
WHERE status = 'FULFILLED' AND metadata_plt != 'true'
  AND customer_type ILIKE '%sme%' AND customer_flag = 'WE_Customer';

Meaning / Logic: Consigner freight fare net of freight differences.
SQL:
SELECT SUM(consigner_freight_fare)
     - SUM(COALESCE(freight_difference,0) - COALESCE(freight_difference_reversal,0))
FROM mp_demand_details
WHERE status = 'FULFILLED' AND metadata_plt != 'true'
  AND customer_type ILIKE '%sme%' AND customer_flag = 'WE_Customer';

Meaning / Logic: EDPE + FO activation + middle share + net coupon.
SQL:
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(edpe_bonus,0) + COALESCE(fo_activation_bonus,0)
         + COALESCE(middle_share_bonus,0)
         + COALESCE(shipper_discount,0) - COALESCE(shipper_discount_reversal,0))
FROM mp_demand_details
WHERE status = 'FULFILLED' AND metadata_plt != 'true'
  AND customer_type ILIKE '%sme%' AND customer_flag = 'WE_Customer';

Meaning / Logic: Total discount over Revenue.
SQL:
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(edpe_bonus,0) + COALESCE(fo_activation_bonus,0)
         + COALESCE(middle_share_bonus,0)
         + COALESCE(shipper_discount,0) - COALESCE(shipper_discount_reversal,0)) * 1.0
     / NULLIF(SUM(consigner_freight_fare)
            - SUM(COALESCE(freight_difference,0) - COALESCE(freight_difference_reversal,0)), 0)
FROM mp_demand_details
WHERE status = 'FULFILLED' AND metadata_plt != 'true'
  AND customer_type ILIKE '%sme%' AND customer_flag = 'WE_Customer';

Meaning / Logic: share of coupon discount of the total discount
SQL:
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(shipper_discount,0) - COALESCE(shipper_discount_reversal,0)) * 1.0
     / NULLIF(SUM(wfms_consigner_freight_fare
                - COALESCE(shipper_discount,0) + COALESCE(shipper_discount_reversal,0)), 0)
FROM mp_demand_details a
JOIN fact_consigner_demands_lead_source b ON b.demand_id = a.demand_id
WHERE b.trip_flag = 1;

Meaning / Logic: share of non-coupon discount of the total discount
SQL:
SELECT SUM(extra_discount) * 1.0
     / NULLIF(SUM(wfms_consigner_freight_fare
                - COALESCE(shipper_discount,0) + COALESCE(shipper_discount_reversal,0)), 0)
FROM mp_demand_details a
JOIN fact_consigner_demands_lead_source b ON b.demand_id = a.demand_id
WHERE b.trip_flag = 1;

Meaning / Logic: Markup of base price over what the FO is paid. A markup over supply cost.
SQL:
SELECT SUM(b.base_price - a.supplyfare) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(a.supplyfare), 0)
FROM mp_demand_details a
JOIN fact_consigner_demands_lead_source b ON b.demand_id = a.demand_id
WHERE b.trip_flag = 1;

Meaning / Logic: Markup of consigner freight fare over base price
SQL:
SELECT SUM(consigner_freight_fare - base_price) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(base_price), 0)
FROM fact_consigner_demands_lead_source WHERE trip_flag = 1;

Meaning / Logic: WFMS freight fare net of shipper discount, over fulfilled trips.
SQL:
SELECT SUM(wfms_consigner_freight_fare
         - COALESCE(shipper_discount,0) + COALESCE(shipper_discount_reversal,0))
FROM mp_demand_details a
JOIN fact_consigner_demands_lead_source b ON b.demand_id = a.demand_id
WHERE b.trip_flag = 1;

Meaning / Logic: Mean expected margin per trip
SQL:
SELECT AVG(pnl_expected)
FROM fact_consigner_demands_lead_source WHERE trip_flag = 1;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Billing → DR %.

Of demands in billing (billing_flag = '1'), % with booking_confirmation_status = '1'. Billing confirmation rate.
SQL:
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(booking_confirmation_status) = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pct_billing_to_dr
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE billing_flag = '1';

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Credit Cost %; Cost of Credit.

Credit cost as % of receivable — cost of extending credit to consigners.
SQL:
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(demand_credit_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(receivable_before_settlement), 0) AS pct_credit_cost
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED';

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Delay Chargers (dashboard typo); % Late Fees.

Delay charges collected as % of receivable (penalty fees on late payments).
SQL:
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(delay_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(receivable_before_settlement), 0)
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED';

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Gross NPA; GNPA.

Gross non-performing receivable as % of receivable, for the ≥90-day past-due cohort. Early-warning credit-health signal.
SQL:
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(demand_gross_npa) / NULLIF(SUM(receivable_before_settlement), 0) AS gross_npa
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED' AND days_since_due >= 90;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Net NPA; NNPA.

Net NPA (after recoveries/provisions) as % of receivable, for the ≥180-day past-due cohort. Headline credit-health indicator.
SQL:
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(demand_net_npa) / NULLIF(SUM(receivable_before_settlement), 0) AS net_npa
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED' AND days_since_due >= 180;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Overall Cost %; All-In Payment Cost.

Composite cost % over receivable for ≥180-day past-due cohort: (Net NPA + Credit Cost + Sales Team Cost + Central Cost + Legal Cost + |Discount| − Fee − Delay) / Receivable.
SQL:
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM((demand_net_npa + demand_credit_cost + sales_team_cost
               + central_cost + legal_cost + ABS(payment_discount))
             - (payment_mode_fee + delay_amount))
  / NULLIF(SUM(receivable_before_settlement), 0) AS pct_payment_cost
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED' AND days_since_due >= 180;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Discount %; % Cx Discount.

Discount given to consigners as % of receivable.
SQL:
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(ABS(payment_discount)) / NULLIF(SUM(receivable_before_settlement), 0)
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED';

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Fee Earned; Payment Fee Revenue %.

Payment-mode fee earned as % of receivable (revenue line for Wheelseye, offsets cost).
SQL:
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(payment_mode_fee) / NULLIF(SUM(receivable_before_settlement), 0)
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED';

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Due+15 Recovery; 15-Day Recovery.

Of receivable ≥15 days past due, % recovered within 15 days of due date.
SQL:
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(ABS(recovered_within_15_days)) / NULLIF(SUM(receivable_before_settlement), 0)
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED' AND days_since_due >= 15;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Due+30 Recovery; 30-Day Recovery.

Of receivable ≥30 days past due, % recovered within 30 days of due date.
SQL:
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(ABS(recovered_within_30_days)) / NULLIF(SUM(receivable_before_settlement), 0)
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED' AND days_since_due >= 30;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: On-Time Recovery %; Within Due Date Collection.

Of receivable due, % recovered on or before the due date.
SQL:
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(ABS(recovered_within_due_date)) / NULLIF(SUM(receivable_before_settlement), 0)
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED';

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Advance Revenue Share; % Upfront Revenue.

% of total receivable from Advance, Paul, and Bank billing modes (billing_submode in A4, A2, A0, F1, F2, F3, F4, F5, C1).
SQL:
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN billing_submode IN ('A4','A2','A0','F1','F2','F3','F4','F5','C1')
                   THEN receivable_before_settlement ELSE 0 END)
  / NULLIF(SUM(receivable_before_settlement), 0) AS pct_advance_share
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED';

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Billing Type Summary; Per-Plan Payment Health.

Per-billing-type table: due amount, % contribution, avg DSO, recovery within due, recovery within due+30/15/90/180, Gross NPA, Net NPA. No sales/region split available.
SQL:
-- See Payment Plan Usage CASE for billing_type mapping.
SELECT billing_type,
       SUM(receivable_before_settlement) AS due_amount,
       AVG(demand_dso) AS avg_dso,
       100.0 * SUM(ABS(recovered_within_due_date))
         / NULLIF(SUM(receivable_before_settlement), 0) AS recovery_within_due,
       100.0 * SUM(ABS(CASE WHEN days_since_due >= 90 THEN demand_gross_npa END))
         / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN days_since_due >= 90 THEN receivable_before_settlement END), 0) AS gross_npa
       -- ... rest analogously ...
FROM fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED' AND days_since_due >= 0
GROUP BY billing_type;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: MoM Cost : New; Cost & Recovery Scorecard; Cost Summary Table.

Combined cost-and-recovery table — per interval: total trips, %_cross_180_days, tilldate received %, tilldate pending %, recovery within due+7/15/30/45/180/240, Gross NPA, Net NPA, Credit Cost, Collection Cost (Central+Sales), Collection Cost (Legal), Discount, Payment Fee, Delay Amount, and Overall Cost %.
SQL:
-- Each column = its own ratio over receivable, with its own days_since_due cohort filter.
-- Overall Cost % = Net NPA + Credit Cost + Collection (Central+Sales) + Collection (Legal)
--                + Overall Discount − Payment Fee − Delay Amount.
SELECT date_trunc('month', due_date) AS month,
       100.0 * SUM(ABS(CASE WHEN days_since_due >= 30 THEN recovered_within_30_days END))
         / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN days_since_due >= 30 THEN receivable_before_settlement END), 0) AS recovery_30,
       -- ... other columns analogously ...
       (net_npa + credit_cost + central_sales_collection + legal_collection + discount
        - payment_fee - delay) AS overall_cost_pct
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED' AND days_since_due >= 0
GROUP BY 1;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Billing Type Mix; Payment Mode Distribution.

Distribution of receivable by Billing Type segment (Pay At Loading / Pay At Unloading / Bank / 10-15 / 15-22 / 30-37 / 40-45 / 60-67 / 70-75 Days Credit). The payment-plan mix per period.
SQL:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN billing_submode ILIKE '%A%' THEN 'Pay At Loading'
    WHEN billing_submode ILIKE '%C%' THEN 'Pay At Unloading'
    WHEN billing_submode ILIKE '%F%' THEN 'Bank'
    WHEN billing_submode IN ('W1','W6','W2') THEN '10-15 Days Credit'
    WHEN billing_submode IN ('W3','WT15','WW15') THEN '15-22 Days Credit'
    WHEN billing_submode IN ('W4','W8','WT30','WW30') THEN '30-37 Days Credit'
    WHEN billing_submode IN ('W5','WB30') THEN '40-45 Days Credit'
    WHEN billing_submode IN ('W9','WT60','WW60') THEN '60-67 Days Credit'
    WHEN billing_submode = 'WB60' THEN '70-75 Days Credit'
    ELSE 'Bank'
  END AS billing_type,
  SUM(receivable_before_settlement) * 100.0
    / SUM(SUM(receivable_before_settlement)) OVER (PARTITION BY interval) AS pct_share
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED'
GROUP BY interval, billing_type;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Utilisation : - Trip Rank; Trip-Rank Utilisation Distribution.

For each Trip Rank, % of demands in each utilisation bucket (0-25k / 25-50k / 50-75k / 75k-1L / 1L-1.25L / 1.25L-1.5L / >1.5L) — cumulative distribution. Utilisation = running sum of (Due + Expense − Payment) per customer.
SQL:
-- 3-source running balance per customer:
--   + fact_payment_summary (Due amount, demand_date)
--   + wfms_trip_expense (party_type='CONSIGNER', deleted=false) — signed by category
--   + wfms_consigner_demand_transaction (status='DONE', deleted=false) — signed by category
-- For each demand: utilization = GREATEST(0, running SUM of signed transactions up to demand_date)
-- Bucket utilisation, then cumulative % within each trip_rank.

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % New FO Trips on Credit.

Of trips by Onboarding FOs (trip_rank ≤ 4) in the first 15/30/45/60 days post first trip, % that used a credit billing mode (billing_submode contains 'W').
SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN billing_submode ILIKE '%W%'
                        AND demand_date <= first_trip_date + 30
                      THEN demand_id END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN demand_date <= first_trip_date + 30 THEN demand_id END), 0) AS pct_30d
FROM analytics.fact_payment_summary
WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED'
  AND trip_rank <= 4;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Repeat FO Trips on Credit.

Same as Onboarding Trips on Credit but for Retention FOs (trip_rank > 4).
SQL: -- Same shape as % Onboarding Trips on Credit, with WHERE trip_rank > 4.

Meaning / Logic:

FOs who completed their FIRST trip in the period. Counted on the first event_date where trips_till_date > 0.

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT operator_code)
FROM (
  SELECT operator_code, MIN(event_date) AS first_trip_date
  FROM fact_operators_mp_events
  WHERE trips_till_date > 0
  GROUP BY operator_code
) t
WHERE first_trip_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: # 2nd Trip FOs.

FOs who reached their 2nd trip (trips_till_date > 1). Depth-of-acquisition metric.
SQL:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT operator_code)
FROM (
  SELECT operator_code, MIN(event_date) AS second_trip_date
  FROM fact_operators_mp_events
  WHERE trips_till_date > 1
  GROUP BY operator_code
) t
WHERE second_trip_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases:  # FOs Landed on MP; Active Base

Distinct Fleet Operators (FOs) who landed on the MP section of the Operator App at any point in the period. The denominator for nearly every FO-side conversion %.

Aliases: # Load Detail Page Viewers; # LDP FOs, Load FOs 

Distinct FOs who viewed at least one Load Detail Page (is_checked_loads > 0). Browse-stage indicator.

WHERE landed_on_mp = 1

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Ready FOs 

Distinct FOs whose ready_date is not null AND mp_status = 'MP Ready' — sourced from analytics.fact_operators_onb. Different source from events-based # Ready FO; numbers will not tie out.

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: # Trucks of Ready FOs, Vehicles of Reday fo Verfied or not verified
Total truck-class vehicles owned by Ready FOs (sum of vehicles per FO, not distinct FO count).

FROM analytics.fact_operators_onb f
JOIN (

  FROM analytics.fact_vehicle_info

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: # Verified Vehicles of Ready FOs.

Variant of # Ready FOs Vehicle, restricted to vehicles with verified attributes.

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: # New Subscribers; # Subs FOs, Who have taken Subscription

Distinct FOs who had a successful subscription transaction within the period (apollo_subscription, deleted=false, transaction_status=SUCCESS), exposed via fact_operators_onb.

Aliases: # Plc FO (at FO level); # Token Paid FOs (first token paid for Acquisition tab).

Distinct FOs who paid a token for at least one load (is_token_paid > 0). Commercial-intent volume metric.
SQL:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT operator_code)
FROM fact_operators_mp_events
WHERE landed_on_mp = 1

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: # FOs with Trip; # Tripping FOs , Trip FO

Distinct FOs who completed at least one trip (total_trips_loads > 0).
SQL:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT operator_code)
FROM fact_operators_mp_events
WHERE landed_on_mp = 1
  AND total_trips_loads > 0;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Weekly Active Users; # 7-Day Active FOs,WOW

Distinct Visitors active in the last 7 days of the period. Subset of # Visitors.
SQL:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT operator_code)
FROM fact_operators_mp_events
WHERE landed_on_mp = 1
  AND event_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 7;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % 1st → 2nd Trip (30/60/180D).

Of FOs acquired (1st trip), % who did 2nd trip within 30/60/180 days of 1st trip.
SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN second_trip_date <= first_trip_date + 30 THEN operator_code END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT operator_code), 0) AS pct_2nd_30d
FROM (
  SELECT operator_code,
         MIN(CASE WHEN trips_till_date >= 1 THEN event_date END) AS first_trip_date,
         MIN(CASE WHEN trips_till_date >= 2 THEN event_date END) AS second_trip_date
  FROM fact_operators_mp_events
  GROUP BY operator_code
) c
WHERE first_trip_date IS NOT NULL;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % 1st → 3rd Trip (30/60/180D).

Of FOs acquired, % who completed 3 trips within 30/60/180 days of 1st trip.
SQL: -- Same shape as % Acquired to 2nd Trip but with trips_till_date >= 3 for the third_trip_date.

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Bidding Adoption; % FO using Bidding.,BID FOs

Share of Visitors who submitted a bid on at least one load (count_of_loads_bid_submit > 0). Data starts Dec-2025.
SQL:
SELECT

WHERE landed_on_mp = 1

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Visitor to LDP; % Load Detail Page FO.

# LDP FO / # Visitors — share of base that browsed at least one load.
SQL:

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Load Detail to Token; LDP→Plc%.

# Token Paid FO / # LDP FO — browse-to-pay conversion at FO level.

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_token_paid > 0 THEN operator_code END) * 1.0

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Matching Adoption.

Share of Visitors who used the matching feature (is_checked_loads_matching > 0). Data starts Jun-2025.
SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_checked_loads_matching > 0 THEN operator_code END) * 1.0

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Filter Usage FO; % FO using ODVT Filter.

Share of Visitors who applied a loading or unloading filter (Origin-Destination-Vehicle-Type).
SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_loading_filter_used = 1
                        OR is_unloading_filter_used = 1

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Sub to Trip (7D / 30D / Lifetime).

Of Subscribed FOs, % who completed first trip within the selected window (7D / 30D / Lifetime variants).
SQL:
SELECT
  s.sub_date_window,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_date <= s.sub_date + 7 AND e.trips_till_date > 0
                      THEN s.operator_code END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.operator_code), 0) AS pct_sub_to_trip_7d
FROM analytics.fact_operators_onb s
LEFT JOIN fact_operators_mp_events e ON s.operator_code = e.operator_code
WHERE s.has_sub = 1
GROUP BY s.sub_date_window;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Placement to Trip FO.

# Trip FO / # Plc FO — % of paying FOs who actually completed a trip.
SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_trips_loads > 0 THEN operator_code END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_placed_loads > 0 THEN operator_code END), 0) AS pct_plc_to_trip
FROM fact_operators_mp_events;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Visitor to Ready.

# Ready FO / # Visitors — share of base that completed the readiness gate.
SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ready_fo = 1 THEN operator_code END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT operator_code), 0) AS pct_ready
FROM fact_operators_mp_events
WHERE landed_on_mp = 1;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Ready FO; % Ready Not Active in last 90 days

Share of cumulative Ready FOs who have NOT placed any token in the last 90 days — the dormant-Ready pool.
SQL:
WITH ready AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT operator_code
  FROM fact_operators_mp_events
  WHERE ready_fo = 1
),
recent_plc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT operator_code
  FROM fact_operators_mp_events
  WHERE total_placed_loads > 0
    AND event_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 90
)
SELECT
  (COUNT(DISTINCT r.operator_code) - COUNT(DISTINCT p.operator_code)) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT v.operator_code), 0) AS pct_dormant_ready
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT operator_code FROM fact_operators_mp_events WHERE landed_on_mp = 1) v
LEFT JOIN ready r ON v.operator_code = r.operator_code
LEFT JOIN recent_plc p ON v.operator_code = p.operator_code;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % FO doing Reverse Leg.

Share of Trip FOs who completed at least one reverse trip (reverse_loads_trips = 1). Denominator is Trip FOs (not Visitors).
SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN second_trip_date <= first_trip_date + 30 THEN operator_code END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT operator_code), 0) AS pct_2nd_30d
FROM (
  SELECT operator_code,
         MIN(CASE WHEN trips_till_date >= 1 THEN event_date END) AS first_trip_date,
         MIN(CASE WHEN trips_till_date >= 2 THEN event_date END) AS second_trip_date
  FROM fact_operators_mp_events
  GROUP BY operator_code
) c
WHERE first_trip_date IS NOT NULL;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Plc FO; % Visitor to Token Paid.

# Token Paid FO / # Visitors. Share of base that committed via token payment.
SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_token_paid > 0 THEN operator_code END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT operator_code), 0) AS pct_token_paid
FROM fact_operators_mp_events
WHERE landed_on_mp = 1;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Token to Placement.

# Plc FO / # Token Paid FO. Note: in most readings Plc and Token Paid are synonymous;
SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_placed_loads > 0 THEN operator_code END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_token_paid > 0 THEN operator_code END), 0) AS pct_token_to_plc
FROM fact_operators_mp_events;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Visitor to Trip; % Trip Conversion.,Trip FO

# Trip FO / # Visitors — end-to-end Visitor → Trip conversion at FO level.
SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_trips_loads > 0 THEN operator_code END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT operator_code), 0) AS pct_trip_fo
FROM fact_operators_mp_events
WHERE landed_on_mp = 1;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Vehicle Availability Feature Usage.

Share of Visitors who marked Vehicle Available OR Vehicle Not Available (used the VA feature). Data starts Nov-2025.
SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_marked_veh_available = 1
                        OR is_marked_veh_not_available = 1
                      THEN operator_code END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT operator_code), 0) AS pct_va_feature
FROM fact_operators_mp_events
WHERE landed_on_mp = 1
  AND event_date >= '2025-11-01';

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % VA Positive Mark; % FO marked Available.,Vehicle Available Marked

Share of Visitors who explicitly marked vehicle as Available (is_marked_veh_available = 1 , 0 for is_marked_veh_not_available) — positive-intent only, excludes 'Not Available' marks.
SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_marked_veh_available = 1 THEN operator_code END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT operator_code), 0) AS pct_va_positive
FROM fact_operators_mp_events
WHERE landed_on_mp = 1;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Weekly Active.

# WAU divided by # Visitors. Tells you what share of the cumulative base is currently active.
SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 7 THEN operator_code END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT operator_code), 0) AS pct_wau
FROM fact_operators_mp_events
WHERE landed_on_mp = 1;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: % Churn; Lapsed FOs.

Of Trip FOs in the cohort month, count and % whose LAST trip date is more than 1 month before today — i.e., have stopped tripping.
SQL:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT operator_code, DATE_TRUNC('month', event_date) AS cohort_month
  FROM fact_operators_mp_events
  WHERE total_trips_loads > 0
),
last_trip AS (
  SELECT operator_code, MAX(event_date) AS last_trip_date
  FROM fact_operators_mp_events
  WHERE total_trips_loads > 0
  GROUP BY operator_code
)
SELECT
  c.cohort_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.last_trip_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month'
                      THEN c.operator_code END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.operator_code), 0) AS churn_pct
FROM cohort c JOIN last_trip l USING (operator_code)
GROUP BY c.cohort_month;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: fo_segment; FO Cohort by Trips; Trip-Rank Segment.

Lifecycle cohort tag assigned to each FO based on number of completed trips. Values:
  • "0"  → Acquired FOs (0  — new)
  • "1-2"  → Early Retention (1-2 trips)
  • "2+"   → Retained FOs (more than 2 trips — fully retained)

Used as a split / cohort filter, NOT as a standalone metric. Pair with any FO-Growth count or %
(e.g., # Trip FO by fo_segment) to see how the funnel performs per lifecycle stage.
SQL:
SELECT DISTINCT fo_segment
FROM fact_operators_mp_events;
-- (table sometimes referred to as fact_fo_mp_events)

-- Common usage as a split:
SELECT
  fo_segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT operator_code) AS fo_count
FROM fact_operators_mp_events
WHERE landed_on_mp = 1
GROUP BY fo_segment;

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Gross TR, pnl_wo_discount, Take Rate (without Discount)

Expected (pre-cost) P&L divided by consigner freight fare on trips.
SQL:
with consignments_data as (
select consignment_id, demand_id, supplyfare, operator_code, consignment_rank
from mp_analytics_critical.fact_consignments_full
) 


select 
sum(pnl_expected+supplyfare-prev_supplyfare)*1.0/sum(consigner_freight_fare)
from
(
select demand_id, pnl_expected, consigner_freight_fare, trip_flag
from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source
where trip_flag=1) a

left join

( 
select demand_id, latest_consignment_id
from mp_analytics_critical.fact_demands_full ) b
on a.demand_id=b.demand_id

left join

( 
select consignment_id, supplyfare
from consignments_data ) c
on b.latest_consignment_id=c.consignment_id

left join

( 
select demand_id, supplyfare as prev_supplyfare, operator_code as prev_operator_code
from consignments_data
where consignment_rank=1 ) d
on a.demand_id=d.demand_id
